name: Harkon Siege Assault Boot
description: A heavy tactical boot in flat black with a composite armor shell covering the toe, ankle, and shin to mid-calf. The exterior panels have a deliberately aggressive geometry — layered, angular, built for intimidation as much as protection. Worn by corporate enforcement teams and private military contractors in Tier 4 operations. The sole integrates a vibration-dampening layer over a hard-strike heel for breaching kicks.
functionality: Toe and ankle armor rated for ballistic fragmentation and 80J impact. Shin guard integrated to mid-calf. Breach-rated heel delivers approximately 900N force for door-strike use. Sealed against fluid intrusion.
what_it_says: You are well-funded, well-trained, and authorized to use force. This is professional violence equipment.
story_hooks: A pair is recovered from a massacre site — the manufacturer's records show the unit they were assigned to was officially disbanded two years ago.
Someone is selling Harkon boots on the Shelf black market. At Tier 2 prices. No one knows where the supply is coming from.
